name: Fraction Disposition Type 8 Code
definition: Indicates that fractional value should be retained; no rounding.

BUYU.name: Buy Up
BUYU.definition: Buy securities up to next whole number.

CINL.name: Cash In Lieu Of Fraction
CINL.definition: Fractional part of cash. Take cash in lieu of fractions.

DIST.name: Issue Fraction
DIST.definition: Take distribution of fractions in the form of securities.

RDDN.name: Round Down
RDDN.definition: Round the entitlement down to the last full unit/minimum nominal quantity, fractions are discarded.

STAN.name: Round To Nearest
STAN.definition: If the fraction is greater than or equal to 0.5 of the resulting security then round up, else round down as specified in the respective RDUP and RDDN codes.

RDUP.name: Round Up
RDUP.definition: Round up to the next full unit/minimum nominal quantity at no cost.

UKWN.name: Unknown
UKWN.definition: Characteristics of the disposition of fractions are unknown.
